Maya: Ok quick follow-up thread for items we didn't finish in the all-hands Q&A. Recording + slides: https://go.redwood.ai/all-hands/2026-03-20-recording
Maya: I'm collecting any unanswered questions, decisions, and concrete action owners here. Will update the tracker by EOD.
Priya: Pricing clarification we promised: Dedicated per-GPU commit vs per-vCPU equivalent. We're drafting two example invoices to show cost delta. ETA Thurs.
Jorge: Private/VPC beta update: infra needs for customer onboarding are non-trivial. Targeting closed beta mid-May, public beta late June. Will post the infra checklist link shortly.
Samira: SLA note: enterprise SLAs available for Dedicated. For Hosted, we'll post SLOs next week and detail incident escalation in the Console docs.
Ethan: Question from the Q&A about telemetry retention: default 90 days, workspace-level override coming as an enterprise add-on. Ops will own the feature flag.
Maya: Action items (owner -> task -> due):
- Priya -> publish pricing examples & sample invoices -> 2026-03-25
- Jorge -> infra checklist + create eng-runtime issue -> 2026-03-23
- Lia -> draft SLA one-pager with legal & sales -> 2026-03-22
- DevOps -> post canary rollback runbook in #eng-oncall -> 2026-03-24
- Ethan -> add telemetry retention toggle RFC -> 2026-03-29
Priya: Added: we'll include sample customer bill simulations for three usage profiles (startup, mid-market, enterprise).
Jorge: Created issue: https://git.redwood.ai/eng-runtime/issues/2150 (infra checklist + onboarding steps) :white_check_mark:
Lia: SLA one-pager in progress. Legal suggested two variants (standard + security addendum). Will post drafts for review tomorrow.
DevOpsBot: Canary runbook published to #eng-oncall: https://go.redwood.ai/docs/canary-rollout v1.0.1 :robot_face:
Ethan: Exec ask: please add colored status tags to the action tracker (blocked/in-progress/done) and include owner email addresses in issue templates.
Maya: Good asks. We'll add triage labels and update templates. Lia, can you own label naming convention?
Lia: Yep. I'll propose label names and the email format for owners by EOD Tue.
Priya: UI note: product will show per-route rollback in the next Console patch; mockups posted in #product-design later today.
Maya: If there are any outstanding Qs from the live chat that we missed, drop them here and I'll route to the right owner. I'll ping owners daily until these are closed. :spiral_calendar:
Samira: Finance: we won't change public pricing until pilot metrics confirm cost neutrality. We'll share a summary with pilot customers before rolling anything out.
Maya: Thanks all. Keeping this short 00 — will convert to action items in linear and tag owners. If you need something moved to "blocked" please call it out here.
